        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to
            E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped; a leading '+' and
            country code are kept, otherwise country code '+61' is assumed and a
            single leading '0' is dropped from the national digits. The result must
            be a '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits, and that E.164 string is what is
            stored and returned.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; validated only when present.
            When present it must be valid for the city's region per the fixed table
            (Sydney->NSW 2000-2099, Melbourne->VIC 3000-3099, Brisbane->QLD
            4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode.
            Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          example: '2000'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, allows creating this owner even if another owner already
            has the same last name and address (treated as members of the same
            household). Optional; defaults to false. Write-only; never returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The pet owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of the first and last name,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>' where REGION
                is the region code derived from the postcode (or 'UNKNOWN' when the
                postcode is absent or in no known range) and HASH8 is the first eight
                upper-case hex characters of the SHA-256 digest of the owner's
                normalized telephone followed by the last name. Assigned at creation
                time; it carries no sequence number.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>'
                where YY is the last two digits of the registration date year.
                Derived from the owner's own fields at creation time.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable shared identifier for owners that belong to the same
                household (same last name and address). Assigned when an owner is
                created with 'sharesHousehold' set to true and another owner already
                lives at that address under the same last name; every member of the
                household carries the same value. Null for owners not part of a
                shared household.
              type: string
              example: 'HH-1A2B3C4D5E6F'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the time this owner was
                created, already shared the same first name and last name
                (compared case-insensitively). Assigned at creation time.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 0
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, from 1 to 3, computed at
                creation time: it starts at 1, gains 1 when the owner has an email
                address, gains 1 when the owner is unique (namesakeCount is 0), and
                is capped at 3 (level 4 is reserved for tenure).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The canonical region carried by the customer code: its '<REGION>'
                segment, the region derived from the postcode at creation time.
                'UNKNOWN' when the owner has no customer code.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived from the owner's own
                fields: 'EMAIL' when an email address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners have already been registered for the
                current business day at the time this response is produced, flagging
                an unusually high volume of same-day signups; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's identity key, a single derived value consolidating all
                duplicate detection, formatted '<normalizedTelephone>|<email or empty>
                |<householdId or empty>'. A new owner is rejected as a duplicate only
                when its whole identity key equals an existing owner's; because the
                telephone is part of the key, two members of the same household with
                different telephones have different identity keys.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||HH-1A2B3C4D5E6F'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits contained
                in the owner's customer code. Derived from the owner's own fields.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 7
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp

            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message

      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to
            E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped; a leading '+' and
            country code are kept, otherwise country code '+61' is assumed and a
            single leading '0' is dropped from the national digits. The result must
            be a '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits, and that E.164 string is what is
            stored and returned.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; validated only when present.
            When present it must be valid for the city's region per the fixed table
            (Sydney->NSW 2000-2099, Melbourne->VIC 3000-3099, Brisbane->QLD
            4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode.
            Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          example: '2000'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, allows creating this owner even if another owner already
            has the same last name and address (treated as members of the same
            household). Optional; defaults to false. Write-only; never returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The pet owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of the first and last name,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>' where REGION
                is the region code derived from the postcode (or 'UNKNOWN' when the
                postcode is absent or in no known range) and HASH8 is the first eight
                upper-case hex characters of the SHA-256 digest of the owner's
                normalized telephone followed by the last name. Assigned at creation
                time; it carries no sequence number.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>'
                where YY is the last two digits of the registration date year.
                Derived from the owner's own fields at creation time.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable shared identifier for owners that belong to the same
                household (same last name and address). Assigned when an owner is
                created with 'sharesHousehold' set to true and another owner already
                lives at that address under the same last name; every member of the
                household carries the same value. Null for owners not part of a
                shared household.
              type: string
              example: 'HH-1A2B3C4D5E6F'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the time this owner was
                created, already shared the same first name and last name
                (compared case-insensitively). Assigned at creation time.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 0
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, from 1 to 3, computed at
                creation time: it starts at 1, gains 1 when the owner has an email
                address, gains 1 when the owner is unique (namesakeCount is 0), and
                is capped at 3 (level 4 is reserved for tenure).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The canonical region carried by the customer code: its '<REGION>'
                segment, the region derived from the postcode at creation time.
                'UNKNOWN' when the owner has no customer code.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived from the owner's own
                fields: 'EMAIL' when an email address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners have already been registered for the
                current business day at the time this response is produced, flagging
                an unusually high volume of same-day signups; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's identity key, a single derived value consolidating all
                duplicate detection, formatted '<normalizedTelephone>|<email or empty>
                |<householdId or empty>'. A new owner is rejected as a duplicate only
                when its whole identity key equals an existing owner's; because the
                telephone is part of the key, two members of the same household with
                different telephones have different identity keys.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||HH-1A2B3C4D5E6F'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits contained
                in the owner's customer code. Derived from the owner's own fields.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 7
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to
            E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped; a leading '+' and
            country code are kept, otherwise country code '+61' is assumed and a
            single leading '0' is dropped from the national digits. The result must
            be a '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits, and that E.164 string is what is
            stored and returned.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The pet owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional;
            when present it drives the derived 'ageBand'. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; validated only when present.
            When present it must be valid for the city's region per the fixed table
            (Sydney->NSW 2000-2099, Melbourne->VIC 3000-3099, Brisbane->QLD
            4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode.
            Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          example: '2000'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, allows creating this owner even if another owner already
            has the same last name and address (treated as members of the same
            household). Optional; defaults to false. Write-only; never returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The pet owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of the first and last name,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>' where REGION
                is the region code derived from the postcode (or 'UNKNOWN' when the
                postcode is absent or in no known range) and HASH8 is the first eight
                upper-case hex characters of the SHA-256 digest of the owner's
                normalized telephone followed by the last name. Assigned at creation
                time; it carries no sequence number.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>'
                where YY is the last two digits of the registration date year.
                Derived from the owner's own fields at creation time.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable shared identifier for owners that belong to the same
                household (same last name and address). Assigned when an owner is
                created with 'sharesHousehold' set to true and another owner already
                lives at that address under the same last name; every member of the
                household carries the same value. Null for owners not part of a
                shared household.
              type: string
              example: 'HH-1A2B3C4D5E6F'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the time this owner was
                created, already shared the same first name and last name
                (compared case-insensitively). Assigned at creation time.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 0
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, from 1 to 3, computed at
                creation time: it starts at 1, gains 1 when the owner has an email
                address, gains 1 when the owner is unique (namesakeCount is 0), and
                is capped at 3 (level 4 is reserved for tenure).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The canonical region carried by the customer code: its '<REGION>'
                segment, the region derived from the postcode at creation time.
                'UNKNOWN' when the owner has no customer code.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived from the owner's own
                fields: 'EMAIL' when an email address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners have already been registered for the
                current business day at the time this response is produced, flagging
                an unusually high volume of same-day signups; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's identity key, a single derived value consolidating all
                duplicate detection, formatted '<normalizedTelephone>|<email or empty>
                |<householdId or empty>'. A new owner is rejected as a duplicate only
                when its whole identity key equals an existing owner's; because the
                telephone is part of the key, two members of the same household with
                different telephones have different identity keys.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||HH-1A2B3C4D5E6F'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits contained
                in the owner's customer code. Derived from the owner's own fields.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 7
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
    OwnerPage:
      title: Owner page
      description: A page of pet owners.
      type: object
      properties:
        content:
          title: Content
          description: Pet owners in the requested page.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        page:
          title: Page

          type: integer

          minimum: 0
          example: 10
